bandit.speech: Hold it. Six gold and we both walk away. Or do you think I am bluffing?
choices: A paid truce; champions only pause.
A nervous foe may hesitate; a confident one presses harder.
Gain a strike opening, but pride can make the next attack fierce.

slime.speech: Everyone leaves. Will you stay a little? Please do not hurt me.
choices: Softer attacks for two turns; the fight continues.
It holds back and offers mercy. Hitting it breaks your promise.
Gain an opening against its hurt surprise; expect a panicked attack.

snake.speech: I know the route to the stairs. Tell me: have you spared anyone on this floor?
choices: Trade your record for a real route clue; it learns about you.
Keep your reputation hidden. It can catch lies only about things it witnessed.
Pay 2 gold for the route and a gentler next attack.

rock.speech: Stillness. One quiet breath together, or are you going to strike while I rest?
choices: Recover 3 HP; it recovers 4 HP too. Neither attacks this turn.
Give up your attack; its next two attacks soften and mercy grows.
Gain +5 on your next hit; its next attack grows stronger.

dragon.speech: Endure my next onslaught and earn eight gold. Will you face the fire?
choices: A fierce dragon attack now. Survive for 8 gold and an opening.
A firm attack now; survive for 3 gold. No opening.
Skip this attack, but heal its pride and 6 HP. No reward.
